description: Personal brand growth for the USER (not a product campaign): every morning it finds up to 5 posts on ONE network (X, LinkedIn, Reddit or YouTube) on the topics the user wants to be known for, each with a draft reply in their voice (no product mentions, no links). The user posts the replies themselves. Free to set up, no credits. After setup the user opens the app link for the free first run (live) and the $5/month subscription that turns on the daily run + morning email (the card step happens in their browser). Before calling: agree with the user on 2-4 topics and their search phrases, one or two sentences about who they are, and a few rules for how their replies should read — draft these from what you know about them and confirm. Calling again updates the assistant in place.

about.description: Who the user is and the angle they add, 1-2 sentences.

network.description: The ONE network where the user wants to be visible: twitter (X), linkedin, reddit or youtube.

topics.description: 1-4 topics the user wants to be known for.

keywords.description: 1-8 search phrases, 1-4 words each, that OTHER people write in posts on this topic. No sentences, hashtags or very broad words ('AI').

voice.description: How their replies should read, one rule per line.

name: setup_growth_assistant
title: Set up my personal growth assistant
